import 'package:context/context.dart';

/// An in-memory exchange used only by the consumer fixtures.
final class HttpExchange {
  final responses = <String>[];

  void respond(String body) => responses.add(body);
}

final _httpKey = ContextKey<HttpExchange>('http');

extension HttpContext on Context {
  HttpExchange get http => require(_httpKey);

  Context withHttp(HttpExchange exchange) =>
      withBinding(_httpKey.bind(exchange));
}
